description_en: Modifies the delivery task configuration of a user, allowing you to set the task name, select fields, specify the real-time log type, and adjust the discard rate
description_zh: 修改用户的任务投递配置，允许设置任务名、选择字段、指定实时日志类型和调整丢弃率
kebab_example: aliyun esa update-user-delivery-task --task-name test_project --field-name ClientRequestID,ClientRequestHost --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateUserDeliveryTask

parameters.help_en: The selected fields, separated by commas (,)
parameters.name: field_name

parameters.help_en:
The real-time log type. Valid values:

dcdn_log_access_l1 (default): access logs.
dcdn_log_er: Edge Routine function logs.
dcdn_log_waf: security protection logs.
dcdn_log_ipa: Layer 4 acceleration logs
parameters.help_zh:
实时日志类型，取值：

dcdn_log_access_l1（默认值）：访问日志。
dcdn_log_er：边缘函数日志。
dcdn_log_waf：安全防护日志。
dcdn_log_ipa：四层加速日志
parameters.name: business_type

parameters.help_en: The discard rate. If not specified, the default value is 0
parameters.name: discard_rate

parameters.help_en: The list of ER PODs to configure
parameters.name: details

parameters.help_en:
The version of the filter rule.

Compatible with legacy filter rules. The default value is v1. Newly created tasks use v2
parameters.help_zh:
Filter 过滤规则版本

兼容旧版本过滤规则，默认是v1，新创建是v2
parameters.name: filter_ver
